remarks: Charming & Stylishly Renovated Condo - A Perfect Retreat Step into this beautifully reimagined 2-bedroom condo, where modern elegance meets cozy charm. Nestled just one flight up, this inviting home has been completely renovated with thoughtful details. The brand-new kitchen, adorned with sleek cabinetry, gleaming stainless steel appliances, and stunning countertops, is a dream for cooking and entertaining. Soft, natural light dances through the new slider, leading to a deck-your serene escape, perfect for sipping morning coffee or unwinding under the stars. The renovated bathroom features contemporary finishes, while the spacious bedrooms, freshly painted and dressed in plush new carpets, create a warm and restful retreat. No pets. Landlord allergic  With the added convenience of a garage, a reserved parking spot, and extra storage, this home has beauty and practicality. Ideally located near major highways, you're never far from where you need to be-yet always close to home.  No pets-landlord is allergic.
